text:
maria_cs: FYI — Arborea onboarding just dropped a vendor security questionnaire (xlsx). Main asks: encryption-at-rest KMS details, SOC2 scope confirmation, and whether we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated. Linking file: https://files.company/arborea-vendor.xlsx :wave:
aj_security: thanks. Do we know if they're planning Dedicated or Hosted? CMKs only available for Dedicated/private, right? :lock:
sam_se: correct — CMK for Dedicated/Private only. For Hosted we can share our KMS architecture and support BYOK via dedicated tenants, but not cross-tenant CMKs. I'll draft suggested answers.
ev an_legal: quick note — they asked for subcontractor list and data processing addendum version. We should attach the current DPA + SOC2 SOC2 cert link. Avoid adding sensitive internal diagrams.
maria_cs: @rita_customer can you confirm deployment target (hosted vs dedicated) and whether they require evidence of encryption keys being customer-owned? They marked "required" on line 12.
rita_customer: Hi team — thanks for the ping. Arborea's security lead (Meera) is asking for customer-managed keys for compliance. They'd prefer Dedicated but evaluating cost. They want example KMS ARNs and key rotation policy. ETA from them: contract review by EOW.
aj_security: got it. @sam_se I'll need the KMS example snippet and rotation cadence. Also clarify whether we rotate keys automatically or provide rotation guidance for BYOK.
sam_se: putting a quick snippet they can paste into questionnaire:```KMS Key Example (Dedicated): arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
Rotation policy: automatic annual rotation managed by customer or 90-day rotation recommended for BYOK.
Hosted: keys are provider-managed, envelope encryption with CMKs in our tenant; we supply attestation and audit logs on request.```
ev an_legal: add this sentence for procurement Qs: "Redwood will provide a current SOC2 Type II report under NDA; DPA v2.3 is the governing data processing agreement. Subprocessors list available upon request."
maria_cs: action items: (1) @sam_se finalize the questionnaire answers and attach SOC2 link, (2) @aj_security provide one-page KMS architecture blurb, (3) @evan_legal add proc/contract language. I will reply to Arborea with a draft by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
vendor-bot: Uploaded file: arborea-vendor.xlsx (12.3 KB)
rita_customer: that's great — Meera asked if you can show a sample key policy for the BYOK flow. She wants to see least-privilege example.
aj_security: quick sample policy snippet for BYOK (keep short):```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow","Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKeyManager"},"Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource": "*"}
  ]
}```I'll sanitize ARNs before sending.
sam_se: adding a note: if they choose Hosted we can offer a dedicated tenant isolation + audit stream, which sometimes satisfies auditors without BYOK. Might be a lower-cost alternative.
maria_cs: perfect — looping in @evan_legal for final sign-off then I'll send to Meera. Thanks team.
ev an_legal: FYI I'll add the NDA note and attach DPA link before signoff.
maria_cs: (sent) Draft reply to Arborea: short Qs and attachments. Will paste final thread here after Meera responds.
